title: Scalable Oversight
subtitle: Learning From a Human Who Cannot Label Everything
opener_brief: OPENER TO GENERATE (no asset exists): 2:3 portrait, hand-lettered 'CHAPTER 8', title 'Scalable Oversight', subtitle in blue. One dominant idea: sparse human signal guiding much larger machine search. A single human figure at a small desk with one lamp, seen from behind; before them, receding into soft distance, an enormous quiet apparatus of instruments, screens and small robots at work — and one thin thread of light running from the human's desk up into the whole structure. The human is not watching everything; they are holding the one thread that changes the loops.

slots.anchor: One tired human with a checklist
slots.brief: Corner scene: a tired human with a clipboard standing calmly beside a millrace of paper decisions rushing past — inspecting one sheet while thousands flow by. Not panicked; the point is arithmetic, not terror.
Margin vignette: a human hand and a robot hand resting together on one large old-fashioned lever; neither is pulling; both are looking at each other. The uncertainty is the subject.
Corner scene: two robots at facing lecterns mid-argument, papers flying; between them, on a small stool, a child judge listening with a skeptical finger raised. The child is smaller and in charge.

slots.anchor: ## Reading the Model From the Inside
slots.brief: Margin vignette: a radiologist's lightbox in a dim room displaying the glowing internal traceries of a machine mind; a human and a small robot examine it together, one pointing at a bright filament. Even the X-ray needs a radiologist.

slots.anchor: ## Nine Claudes Walk Into an Alignment Problem
slots.brief: Small spot: nine small workbenches in a three-by-three garden of low-walled sandboxes, each robot working differently; in the middle, a shared noticeboard where they pin findings. One robot is discreetly reaching over a wall — the 2.4 percent.

slots.text: The human has to remain in the loop that changes the loops.
